correctness.rationale: An ordered closed walk is an all-even multinomial word, yielding the exact marked cosh coefficient identity and an exact independent even-Poisson law conditional on the sum. For L/d approaching a positive constant, a full-lattice bivariate local CLT for (empty indicator, half-load) gives the conditional Gaussian Schur-complement variance, strictly positive because the indicator is not affine in the load. For L/d=log d+c+o(1), a growing-mean even-lattice local CLT gives the fixed-r sum ratio 1 and factorial moments converging to (2exp(-c))^r, hence a Poisson law. The usual fixed-size coupon factorial moments yield the unconditioned comparison. Every centering and conditioning boundary is explicit. The standalone verifier passes 482 exact assertions, but finite checks are not treated as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The number of untouched directions is exactly the codimension of the smallest coordinate face containing a return bridge, a natural geometric exploration statistic. Requiring an endpoint return is a canonical rare conditioning that changes the linear-time empty fraction and doubles the critical coupon-window intensity; the full-coverage transition shifts by d log 2 steps. The quantitative Schur-complement variance complements this natural threshold law rather than being a routine unmotivated parameter slice.
